card.name: Forms of the verb speak
card.fires_on: Forms of 'speak' (speaking, speak, speaks, spoke), mostly in general web prose about people voicing views, e.g. 'not speaking out' or 'Speaking of'. Also fires on 'of' or '-ing' where a speech-related word is expected.

modes.label: Speak verb forms
modes.description: The verb speak in some form after a person or 'not', often followed by out, up or of.
modes.example: for not<< speaking>> out against censorship forcefully enough

modes.label: Sentence-opening 'Speaking of'
modes.description: A capitalized Speaking starting a transitional remark.
modes.example: he said. <<Speaking>> of the ground, it too is under

modes.label: Speech-like 'of' or 'ing'
modes.description: The word 'of' or '-ing' where speaking or commenting language is expected.
modes.example: Comment<<ing>> on the potential advantages of mRNA-based vaccines

card.writes: It suppresses speak-related words in several languages, so the pole acts after speak has already appeared and discourages repeating it.
card.plain: It lights up on the word 'speak' and its forms, as in 'speaking out' or 'speaking of'.
